props.description:
The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: indicator
props.description: The track and the thumb sliding over it indicating the on and off status of the Switch.

props.name: input
props.description:
Hidden input that handles the Switch's functionality.

This is the PRIMARY slot: all native properties specified directly on the `<Switch>` tag will be applied to this
slot, except `className` and `style`, which remain on the root slot.

props.name: label
props.description: The Switch's label.

props.name: labelPosition
props.description: The position of the label relative to the Switch.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback to be called when the checked state value changes.

props.name: root
props.description:
The root element of the Switch.

The root slot receives the `className` and `style` specified directly on the `<Switch>` tag.
All other native props will be applied to the primary slot: `input`.

props.name: size
props.description: The size of the Switch.

TabList.description: A tab list provides single selection from a set of tabs.

props.name: appearance
props.description:
A tab list can supports 'transparent' and 'subtle' appearance.
- 'subtle': Minimizes emphasis to blend into the background until hovered or focused.
- 'transparent': No background and border styling
- 'subtle-circular': Adds background and border styling
- 'filled-circular': Adds background styling

The appearance affects each of the contained tabs.

props.name: defaultSelectedValue
props.description:
The value of the tab to be selected by default.
Typically useful when the selectedValue is uncontrolled.

props.name: disabled
props.description: A tab list can be set to disable interaction.

props.description:
The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: onTabSelect
props.description: Raised when a tab is selected.

props.name: reserveSelectedTabSpace
props.description:
Tab size may change between unselected and selected states.
The default scenario is a selected tab has bold text.

When true, this property requests tabs be the same size whether unselected or selected.

props.name: selectedValue
props.description: The value of the currently selected tab.

props.name: selectTabOnFocus
props.description: When true, focusing a tab will select it.

props.name: size
props.description:
A tab list can be either 'small', 'medium', or 'large' size.
The size affects each of the contained tabs.

props.name: vertical
props.description: A tab list can arrange its tabs vertically.

Tag.description:
Tag component -  a visual representation of an attribute.
Provides visual attributes such as media, icon, primary and secondary text, as well as the ability to attach an action (by default it is dismiss)

props.name: appearance
props.description: A Tag can have filled, outlined or brand experience.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: A Tag can be dismissible

props.name: dismissIcon
props.description: Slot for the dismiss icon

TagPicker.description:
TagPicker component -
A TagPicker is a composite component that allows users to pick tags from a list of options.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Controls the colors and borders of the combobox trigger.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The default open state when open is uncontrolled

props.name: defaultSelectedOptions
props.description:
For an uncontrolled component, sets the initial selection.
If this is set, the `defaultValue` prop MUST also be set.

props.name: disableAutoFocus
props.description: Disable auto-focusing on the first item when mounting.

props.name: inline
props.description:
TagPickers are rendered out of DOM order on `document.body` by default,
use this to render the popover in DOM order

props.name: noPopover
props.description:
By default, when a single children is provided, the TagPicker will assume that the children
is a popover. By setting this prop to true, the children will be treated as a trigger instead.

props.name: open
props.description:
Sets the open/closed state of the dropdown.
Use together with onOpenChange to fully control the dropdown's visibility

props.name: positioning
props.description:
Configure the positioning of the combobox dropdown.
Please refer to the [positioning documentation](https://react.fluentui.dev/?path=/docs/concepts-developer-positioning-components--default#anchor-to-target)
for more details.
@defaultvalue below

props.name: selectedOptions
props.description:
An array of selected option keys.
Use this with `onOptionSelect` to directly control the selected option(s)
If this is set, the `value` prop MUST also be controlled.

TeachingPopover.description: An extension class of Popover which defaults to withArrow and FocusTrap enabled.

props.name: appearance
props.description:
A popover can appear styled with brand or inverted.
When not specified, the default style is used.

props.name: closeOnIframeFocus
props.description: Flag to close the Popover when an iframe outside a PopoverSurface is focused

props.name: closeOnScroll
props.description: Close when scroll outside of it

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Used to set the initial open state of the Popover in uncontrolled mode

props.name: inertTrapFocus
props.description:
Enables standard behavior according to the [HTML dialog spec](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLDialogElement/showModal)
where the focus trap involves setting outside elements inert,
making navigation leak from the trapped area back to the browser toolbar and vice-versa.

props.name: inline
props.description: Popovers are rendered out of DOM order on `document.body` by default, use this to render the popover in DOM order

props.name: legacyTrapFocus
props.description:
Must be used with the `trapFocus` prop
Enables older Fluent UI focus trap behavior where the user
cannot tab into the window outside of the document. This is now
non-standard behavior according to the [HTML dialog spec](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLDialogElement/showModal)
where the focus trap involves setting outside elements inert.
@deprecated this behavior is default provided now, to opt-out of it in favor of standard behavior use the `inertTrapFocus` property

props.name: mountNode
props.defaultValue: a new element on document.body without any styling
props.description: Where the portal children are mounted on DOM

props.name: mouseLeaveDelay
props.description: Sets the delay for closing popover on mouse leave

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description:
Call back when the component requests to change value
The `open` value is used as a hint when directly controlling the component

props.name: open
props.description: Controls the opening of the Popover

props.name: openOnContext
props.description: Flag to open the Popover as a context menu. Disables all other interactions

props.name: openOnHover
props.description: Flag to open the Popover by hovering the trigger

props.name: positioning
props.description:
Configures the position of the Popover.
Explore [Positioning docs](https://react.fluentui.dev/?path=/docs/concepts-developer-positioning-components--docs) for more options.

props.name: size
props.description: Determines popover padding and arrow size

props.name: surfaceMotion
props.description:
Slot for the surface motion animation.
For more information refer to the [Motion docs page](https://react.fluentui.dev/?path=/docs/motion-motion-slot--docs).

props.name: trapFocus
props.description: Should trap focus

props.name: unstable_disableAutoFocus
props.description:
By default Popover focuses the first focusable element in PopoverSurface on open.
Specify `disableAutoFocus` to prevent this behavior.

props.name: withArrow
props.description: Display an arrow pointing to the target.

props.description:
The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback for when the user changes the value.

props.name: resize
props.description: Which direction the Textarea is allowed to be resized.

props.name: root
props.description:
Wrapper element used for displaying the borders for Textarea. This wrapper is needed due to the focus
indicator border animation. For more information, see Spec.md

The root only receives `className` and `style`. All other props are applied to the `textarea` slot.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the Textarea.

props.name: textarea
props.description: The `<textarea>` element. This is the primary slot, all native props and ref are applied to this slot.

props.name: value
props.description: The value of the Textarea.

props.description:
The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

Tooltip.description: A tooltip provides light weight contextual information on top of its target element.

props.name: appearance
props.description:
The tooltip's visual appearance.
* `normal` - Uses the theme's background and text colors.
* `inverted` - Higher contrast variant that uses the theme's inverted colors.

props.name: content
props.description: The text or JSX content of the tooltip.

props.name: hideDelay
props.description: Delay before the tooltip is hidden, in milliseconds.

props.name: mountNode
props.defaultValue: a new element on document.body without any styling
props.description: Where the portal children are mounted on DOM

props.name: onVisibleChange
props.type: (event: PointerEvent<HTMLElement> | FocusEvent<HTMLElement, Element>, data: OnVisibleChangeData) => void
props.description:
Notification when the visibility of the tooltip is changing.

**Note**: for backwards compatibility, `event` will be undefined if this was triggered by a keyboard event on
the document element. Use `data.documentKeyboardEvent` if the keyboard event object is needed.

props.name: positioning
props.description: Configure the positioning of the tooltip

props.name: relationship
props.description:
(Required) Specifies whether this tooltip is acting as the description or label of its trigger element.

* `label` - The tooltip sets the trigger's aria-label or aria-labelledby attribute. This is useful for buttons
   displaying only an icon, for example.
* `description` - The tooltip sets the trigger's aria-description or aria-describedby attribute.
* `inaccessible` - No aria attributes are set on the trigger. This makes the tooltip's content inaccessible to
  screen readers, and should only be used if the tooltip's text is available by some other means.

props.name: showDelay
props.description: Delay before the tooltip is shown, in milliseconds.

props.name: visible
props.description:
Control the tooltip's visibility programatically.

This can be used in conjunction with onVisibleChange to modify the tooltip's show and hide behavior.

If not provided, the visibility will be controlled by the tooltip itself, based on hover and focus events on the
trigger (child) element.

props.description:
The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.description:
The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.description:
The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: checkmark
props.description:
A helper slot for alignment when a menu item is used with selectable menuitems
Avoid using this slot as a replacement for MenuItemCheckbox and MenuItemRadio components

props.name: content
props.description:
Component children are placed in this slot
Avoid using the `children` property in this slot in favour of Component children whenever possible

props.name: disabledFocusable
props.description:
@deprecated this property does nothing.
disabled focusable is by default by simply using `disabled` property

props.description:
The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon slot rendered before children content

props.name: secondaryContent
props.description: Secondary content rendered opposite the primary content (e.g Shortcut text)

MenuItemRadio.description: Define a styled MenuItemRadio, using the `useMenuItemRadio_unstable` hook.

props.name: checkmark
props.description:
A helper slot for alignment when a menu item is used with selectable menuitems
Avoid using this slot as a replacement for MenuItemCheckbox and MenuItemRadio components

props.name: content
props.description:
Component children are placed in this slot
Avoid using the `children` property in this slot in favour of Component children whenever possible

props.name: disabledFocusable
props.description:
@deprecated this property does nothing.
disabled focusable is by default by simply using `disabled` property

props.description:
The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.description:
The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

MenuSplitGroup.description: Layout wrapper that provides extra keyboard navigation behavior for two `MenuItem` components.

props.description:
The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

A MenuGridCell can be visually hidden, which is used for asymmetric grids
@defaultvalue false

point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.description:
The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.description:
The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.description:
The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: gap
props.description: Defines gap between each two adjacent child items.

props.name: hAlign
props.description: Controls items alignment in horizontal direction.

props.name: inline
props.description: Defines if container should be inline element.

props.name: padding
props.description: Defines container's padding.

props.name: space
props.description: Defines strategy for distributing remaining space between items.

props.name: vAlign
props.description: Controls items alignment in vertical direction.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Allows overflow items to wrap on the next container's line.

props.description:
The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: weight
props.description: Applies font weight to the content.

props.name: wrap

props.name: controls
props.description: Whether the video should display controls

props.description:
The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: loop
props.description: Whether the video should loop

props.name: muted
props.description: Whether the video should be muted

props.name: poster
props.description: The URL of an image to display while the video is loading

props.name: src
props.description: The source URL of the video

AppItem.description: AppItem component - Application item in the navigation menu.

props.name: disabledFocusable
props.description:
When set, allows the button to be focusable even when it has been disabled.
This is used in scenarios where it is important to keep a consistent tab order
for screen reader and keyboard users. The primary example of this
pattern is when the disabled button is in a menu or a commandbar and is seldom used for standalone buttons.

props.description:
The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: icon
props.description:
Icon that renders before the content.
Should be specific to each Category

NavDivider.description: NavDivider component - a divider used within navigation components to separate items.

props.name: alignContent
props.description: Determines the alignment of the content within the divider.

props.name: appearance
props.description:
A divider can have one of the preset appearances.
When not specified, the divider has its default appearance.

props.description:
The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: inset
props.description: Adds padding to the beginning and end of the divider.

props.name: vertical
props.description: A divider can be horizontal (default) or vertical.

props.name: wrapper
props.description: Wrapper for content when presented.

NavDrawer.description: NavDrawer component - a component that provides a drawer for navigation items.

props.name: backdrop
props.description:
Dimmed background of dialog.
The default backdrop is rendered as a `<div>` with styling.
This slot expects a `<div>` element which will replace the default backdrop.
The backdrop should have `aria-hidden="true"`.

Accepts an `appearance` prop to control backdrop visibility:
- `'dimmed'`: Always shows a dimmed backdrop, regardless of nesting.
- `'transparent'`: Always shows a transparent backdrop.
@example ```tsx
<DialogSurface backdrop={{ appearance: 'dimmed' }} />
```

Typically useful when the selectedValue is uncontrolled.
Mutually exclusive with selectedValue.
Empty string indicates no selection.

Dialog variations.

`modal`: When this type of dialog is open, the rest of the page is dimmed out and cannot be interacted with.
The tab sequence is kept within the dialog and moving the focus outside
the dialog will imply closing it. This is the default type of the component.

`non-modal`: When a non-modal dialog is open, the rest of the page is not dimmed out
and users can interact with the rest of the page.
This also implies that the tab focus can move outside the dialog when it reaches the last focusable element.

`alert`: is a special type of modal dialogs that interrupts the user's workflow
to communicate an important message or ask for a decision.
Unlike a typical modal dialog, the user must take an action through the options given to dismiss the dialog,
and it cannot be dismissed through the dimmed background.

props.name: onOpenChange
open

props.name: openCategories
props.description:
Controls the open categories.
For use in controlled scenarios.

Position of the drawer.

Note: 'bottom' does not supports size, but it supports customized height.

props.description:

The value of the currently selected navItem.
Mutually exclusive with defaultSelectedValue.

props.description:
Size of the drawer.

- 'small' - Drawer is 320px wide.
- 'medium' - Drawer is 592px wide.
- 'large' - Drawer is 940px wide.
- 'full' - Drawer is 100vw wide.

props.name: tabbable
props.description:
The component uses arrow navigation by default.
Setting this to true enables tab AND arrow navigation.

props.name: type
props.description:
Type of the drawer.

- 'overlay' - Drawer is hidden by default and can be opened by clicking on the trigger.
- 'inline' - Drawer is stacked with the content

props.name: unmountOnClose
props.description:
Decides whether the drawer should be removed from the DOM tree when it is closed.
This can be useful when dealing with components that may contain state that should not
be reset when the drawer is closed.

props.description:
The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.description:
When set, allows the button to be focusable even when it has been disabled.
This is used in scenarios where it is important to keep a consistent tab order
for screen reader and keyboard users. The primary example of this
pattern is when the disabled button is in a menu or a commandbar and is seldom used for standalone buttons.

props.description:
The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

NavSubItem.description: NavSubItem component - a sub-item within a navigation structure.

props.name: disabledFocusable
props.description:
When set, allows the button to be focusable even when it has been disabled.
This is used in scenarios where it is important to keep a consistent tab order
for screen reader and keyboard users. The primary example of this
pattern is when the disabled button is in a menu or a commandbar and is seldom used for standalone buttons.

props.description:
The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: menuButton
props.description: Menu button slot to stuff more things in when the other two aren't enough.

props.name: menuButtonTooltip
props.description: Tooltip for the menu button.

props.name: navItem
props.description:
The NavItem Slot.
Will behave as a SubNavItem if it's in an a SubGroup.

props.name: toggleButton
props.description: Toggle button slot

props.name: toggleButtonTooltip
props.description: Tooltip for the toggle button.

OverflowDivider.description:
Attaches overflow item behavior to its child registered with the OverflowContext.
It does not render an element of its own.

props.name: groupId
props.description: Assigns the item to a group, group visibility can be watched.

OverflowItem.description:
Attaches overflow item behavior to its child registered with the OverflowContext.
It does not render an element of its own.

Behaves similarly to other `*Trigger` components in Fluent UI React.

props.name: groupId
props.description: Assigns the item to a group, group visibility can be watched.

props.name: id
props.description: The unique identifier for the item used by the overflow manager.

props.name: pinned
props.description:
If true, the item will never overflow and will always be visible.
Mutually exclusive with `priority`.

props.name: priority
props.description:
A higher priority means the item overflows later.
Mutually exclusive with `pinned`.

PopoverSurface.description: PopoverSurface component renders react children in a positioned box

props.description:
The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

PopoverTrigger.description: Wraps a trigger element as an only child and adds the necessary event handling to open a popover.

props.name: disableButtonEnhancement
props.description: Disables internal trigger mechanism that ensures a child provided will be a compliant ARIA button.

Portal.description:
A portal provides a way to render children into a DOM node
that exists outside the DOM hierarchy of the parent component.

props.name: mountNode
props.defaultValue: a new element on document.body without any styling
props.description: Where the portal children are mounted on DOM

props.name: applyStylesToPortals
props.description: Passes styles applied to a component down to portals if enabled.

props.name: indicator
props.description: A circle outline, with a filled circle icon inside when the Radio is checked.

props.name: input
props.description:
Hidden input that handles the radio's functionality.

This is the PRIMARY slot: all native properties specified directly on `<Radio>` will be applied to this slot,
except `className` and `style`, which remain on the root slot.

props.name: label
props.description: The Radio's label.

props.name: labelPosition
props.description:
The position of the label relative to the radio indicator.

This defaults to `after` unless the Radio is inside a RadioGroup with `layout="horizontalStacked"`,
in which case it defaults to `below`.
@defaultvalue after

props.name: onChange
props.description:
Callback when this Radio is selected in its group.

**Note:** `onChange` is NOT called when this Radio is deselected.
Use RadioGroup's `onChange` event to determine when the selection in the group changes.

props.name: root
props.description:
The root element of the Radio.

The root slot receives the `className` and `style` specified directly on the `<Radio>`.
All other native props will be applied to the primary slot: `input`

props.description:
The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: unselectedIcon

props.description: The positive whole number value that is displayed by this RatingItem

props.description:
The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: shape
props.description:
Sets the shape of the SkeletonItems inside the Skeleton.
This value can be overridden by the individual SkeletonItem's `shape` prop.

props.name: size
props.description:
Sets the size of the SkeletonItems inside the Skeleton in pixels.
Size is restricted to a limited set of values recommended for most uses (see SkeletonItemSize).
This value can be overridden by the individual SkeletonItem's `size` prop.

props.description:
The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.description:
The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusMode
props.description:
Used when there are nested focusble elements inside a focusable cell
- `group`: Enter keypress moves focus inside the cell, focus is trapped inside the cell until Escape keypress
- `cell`: The cell is focusable - if there are focusable elements in the cell use `group`
- `none`: The cell is not focusable

props.description:
The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusMode
props.description:
Used when there are nested focusble elements inside a focusable cell
- `group`: Enter keypress moves focus inside the cell, focus is trapped inside the cell until Escape keypress
- `cell`: The cell is focusable - if there are focusable elements in the cell use `group`
- `none`: The cell is not focusable

props.name: appearance
props.description:
A table row can have different variants. These appearances are
intended to be used with selection.

props.description:
The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.description:
The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.description:
The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.description:
The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: appearance
props.description:
A table row can have different variants. These appearances are
intended to be used with selection.

props.description:
The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.description:
The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.description:
The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: text
props.description:
An optional override the string value of the Option's display text,
defaulting to the Option's child content.
This is used as the Dropdown button's or Combobox input's value when the option is selected,
and as the comparison for type-to-find keyboard functionality.
The string value of the Option's display text when the Option's children are not a string.
This is used as the Dropdown button's or Combobox input's value when the option is selected,
and as the comparison for type-to-find keyboard functionality.

props.description:
The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: hasSecondaryAction
props.description:
Whether the `InteractionTag` component has a `Secondary` component that provides an secondary action.
If `true`, the `InteractionTagPrimary` component will adjust its styles to accommodate the `Secondary` component.

props.name: icon
props.description: Slot for an icon

props.name: media
props.description: Slot for a visual element, usually an avatar

props.name: primaryText
props.description: Main text for the InteractionTagPrimary button. Children of the root slot are automatically rendered here

props.name: secondaryText
props.description: Secondary text that describes or complements the main text

InteractionTagSecondary.description: InteractionTagSecondary component - used as the second child of the `InteractionTag` component and provides the secondary action, which is dismiss by default.

props.description:
The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

TeachingPopoverBody.description:
Define a styled TeachingPopoverBody, using the `useTeachingPopoverBody_unstable` and `useTeachingPopoverBodyStyles_unstable`
hooks.

TeachingPopoverBody is used to host content within a TeachingPopover, and provides a standardized media slot

props.description:
The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: value
props.description:
The value used to identify a page,
it should be unique and is necessary for pagination

TeachingPopoverCarouselFooter.description:
Define a styled TeachingPopoverCarouselFooter, using the `useTeachingPopoverCarouselFooter_unstable` and `useTeachingPopoverCarouselFooterStyles_unstable`
hooks.

TeachingPopoverCarouselFooter contains previous/next buttons configured for carousel navigation, and a root slot for page count and/or page index navigation.

props.name: finalStepText
props.description: The text to be displayed on the final step of carousel

TeachingPopoverCarouselNavButton.description:
TeachingPopoverCarouselNavButton is a button to jump to a single page within TeachingPopoverCarousel

It's value is injected via context and must be wrapped with a ValueIdContextProvider (automatically handled via TeachingPopoverCarouselNav)

props.name: disabledFocusable
props.description:
When set, allows the button to be focusable even when it has been disabled.
This is used in scenarios where it is important to keep a consistent tab order
for screen reader and keyboard users. The primary example of this
pattern is when the disabled button is in a menu or a commandbar and is seldom used for standalone buttons.

props.description:
The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

TeachingPopoverCarouselPageCount.description:
TeachingPopoverCarouselPageCount is a simple interface for rendering based on current and total page count

The child render function will provide both current and total page numbers for customization.

props.description:
The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

TeachingPopoverFooter.description:
Define a styled TeachingPopoverFooter, using the `useTeachingPopoverFooter_unstable` and `useTeachingPopoverFooterStyles_unstable`
hooks.

TeachingPopoverFooter will provide both a secondary and primary button for the TeachingPopover,
and handle Popover functionality such as closing the popup.

Users must provide the localized text for each button within the footer via slots.

props.description:
The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

TeachingPopoverTitle.description:
Define a styled TeachingPopoverTitle, using the `useTeachingPopoverTitle_unstable` and `useTeachingPopoverTitleStyles_unstable`
hooks.

TeachingPopoverTitle is similar to TeachingPopoverHeader, but it is intended to be placed within a TeachingPopoverBody
TeachingPopoverTitle can also optionally render a dismiss button, however this should only be enabled when there is no TeachingPopoverHeader/dismiss.

props.name: dismissButton
props.description: An alternate close button path if not placed in the TeachingPopoverHeader

props.description:
The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: formatDateToTimeString
props.description: Customizes the formatting of date strings displayed in dropdown options.

props.name: hourCycle
props.description:
A string value indicating whether the 12-hour format ("h11", "h12") or the 24-hour format ("h23", "h24") should be used.
- 'h11' and 'h23' start with hour 0 and go up to 11 and 23 respectively.
- 'h12' and 'h24' start with hour 1 and go up to 12 and 24 respectively.

props.name: increment
props.description: Time increment, in minutes, of the options in the dropdown.

props.name: inlinePopup
props.description:
Render the combobox's popup inline in the DOM.
This has accessibility benefits, particularly for touch screen readers.

props.name: input
props.description: The primary slot, an input with role="combobox"

props.name: listbox
props.description: The dropdown listbox slot

props.name: mountNode
props.defaultValue: a new element on document.body without any styling
props.description: Where the portal children are mounted on DOM

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Callback when the open/closed state of the dropdown changes

props.name: onTimeChange
props.description: Callback for when a time selection is made.

props.name: open
props.description:
Sets the open/closed state of the dropdown.
Use together with onOpenChange to fully control the dropdown's visibility

props.name: parseTimeStringToDate
props.description: In the freeform TimePicker, customizes the parsing from the input time string into a Date and provides custom validation.

props.name: positioning
props.description:
Configure the positioning of the combobox dropdown.
Please refer to the [positioning documentation](https://react.fluentui.dev/?path=/docs/concepts-developer-positioning-components--default#anchor-to-target)
for more details.
@defaultvalue below

props.name: root
props.description: The root combobox slot

props.name: selectedTime
props.description: Currently selected time in the TimePicker.

props.name: showSeconds
props.description: If true, show seconds in the dropdown options and consider seconds for default validation purposes.

props.name: size
props.description: Controls the size of the combobox faceplate

props.name: startHour
props.description: Start hour (inclusive) for the time range, 0-24.

props.description:
The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: intent
props.description:
Default toast types that determine the urgency or [aria-live](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA/ARIA_Live_Regions) narration
The UI layer may use these intents to apply specific styling.

props.name: onStatusChange
props.description: Reports changes to the Toast lifecycle

props.name: order
props.description:
Used to determine default priority when the user does not set one
Simple counter of toasts dispatched.

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.description: Toast timeout pauses while user cursor is on the toast

props.name: pauseOnWindowBlur
props.description: Toast timeout pauses while focus is on another window

props.name: politeness
props.description:
Used to determine [aria-live](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA/ARIA_Live_Regions) narration
This will override the intent prop

props.name: position
props.description: The position the toast should render to

props.name: priority
props.description: Higher priority toasts will be rendered before lower priority toasts

props.name: remove
props.description: Removes a toast completely

props.name: timeout
props.description: Auto dismiss timeout in milliseconds

props.name: toasterId
props.description: Toast belongs to a specific toaster

props.name: toastId
props.description: Uniquely identifies a toast, used for update and dismiss operations

props.name: updateId
props.description: A number used to track updates immutably

props.description:
The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: disableButtonEnhancement
props.description: Disables internal trigger mechanism that ensures a child provided will be a compliant ARIA button.

props.description:
The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

ToolbarRadioGroup.description:
ToolbarRadioGroup component is a Button to be used inside Toolbar
which will respect toolbar props such as `size`

props.description:
The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

FlatTree.description:
The `FlatTree` component is a variation of the `Tree` component that deals with a flattened data structure.

It should be used on cases where more complex interactions with a Tree is required.
On simple scenarios it is advised to simply use a nested structure instead.

props.name: appearance
props.description:
A tree item can have various appearances:
- 'subtle' (default): The default tree item styles.
- 'subtle-alpha': Minimizes emphasis on hovered or focused states.
- 'transparent': Removes background color.

props.name: checkedItems
props.description:
This refers to a list of ids of checked tree items, or a list of tuples of ids and checked state.
Controls the state of the checked tree items.
These property is ignored for subtrees.

props.description:
The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: navigationMode
props.description:
Indicates how navigation between a treeitem and its actions work
- 'tree' (default): The default navigation, pressing right arrow key navigates inward the first inner children of a branch treeitem
- 'treegrid': Pressing right arrow key navigate towards the actions of a treeitem

props.name: onCheckedChange
onNavigation
props.type: (event: MouseEvent<HTMLElement, MouseEvent> | KeyboardEvent<HTMLElement>, data: TreeNavigationDataParam) => void

props.name: onOpenChange
props.type: (event: MouseEvent<HTMLElement, MouseEvent> | KeyboardEvent<HTMLElement>, data: TreeOpenChangeData) => void

props.name: openItems
props.description:
This refers to a list of ids of opened tree items.
Controls the state of the open tree items.
These property is ignored for subtrees.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description:
This refers to the selection mode of the tree.
- undefined: No selection can be done.
- 'single': Only one tree item can be selected, radio buttons are rendered.
- 'multiselect': Multiple tree items can be selected, checkboxes are rendered.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the tree item.

TreeItem.description:
The `TreeItem` component represents a single item in a tree.
It expects a certain order of children to work properly: the first child should be the node itself,
and the second child should be a nested subtree in the form of another Tree component or a standalone TreeItem.
This order follows the same order as document traversal for the TreeWalker API in JavaScript:
https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/TreeWalker.
The content and layout of a TreeItem can be defined using the TreeItemLayout or TreeItemPersonaLayout component,
which should be used as a direct child of TreeItem.

When a TreeItem has nested child subtree, an expand/collapse control is displayed,
allowing the user to show or hide the children.

props.description:
The `focusgroup` attribute is used to indicate that a group of elements should be treated as
a single focusable unit for keyboard navigation purposes. It can be used to create accessible
components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: focusgroupstart
props.description:
The `focusgroupstart` attribute is used to indicate that an element is the starting
point of a focus group. It can be used in conjunction with the `focusgroup` attribute
to create accessible components that support keyboard navigation and focus management.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.type: (e: MouseEvent<HTMLElement, MouseEvent> | KeyboardEvent<HTMLElement>, data: TreeItemOpenChangeData) => void

props.name: open
props.description:
Whether the tree item is in an open state

This overrides the open value provided by the root tree,
and ensure control of the visibility of the tree item per tree item.

NOTE: controlling the open state of a tree item will not affect the open state of its children

props.name: parentValue
props.description: This property is inferred through context on a nested tree, and required for a flat tree.

props.name: value
props.description:
A tree item should have a well defined value, in case one is not provided by the user by this prop
one will be inferred internally.

TreeItemLayout.description:
The `TreeItemLayout` component is used as a child of `TreeItem` to define the content and layout of a tree item.
It provides a consistent visual structure for tree items in a `Tree` component.
This component should only be used as a direct child of `TreeItem`.

props.name: actions
props.description:
Actionable elements are normally buttons, menus, or other focusable elements.
Those elements are only visibly available if the given tree item is currently active.

`actions` and `aside` slots are positioned on the exact same spot,
so they won't be visible at the same time.
`aside` slot is visible by default meanwhile `actions` slot are only visible when the tree item is active.

`actions` slot supports a `visible` prop to force visibility of the actions.

props.name: aside
props.description: Aside content is normally used to render a badge or other non-actionable content

props.name: expandIcon
props.description:
Expand icon slot,
by default renders a chevron icon to indicate opening and closing

props.name: iconAfter
props.description: Icon slot that renders right after main content

props.name: iconBefore
props.description: Icon slot that renders right before main content

props.name: main

TreeItemPersonaLayout.description:
The `TreeItemPersonaLayout` component is used as a child of `TreeItem` to display a `TreeItem` with a media (typically an avatar) and a description.
It provides a more visually appealing representation of a `TreeItem` and is typically used to display a list of people or topics.
This component should only be used as a direct child of `TreeItem`.

props.name: actions
props.description:
Actionable elements are normally buttons, menus, or other focusable elements.
Those elements are only visibly available if the given tree item is currently active.

`actions` and `aside` slots are positioned on the exact same spot,
so they won't be visible at the same time.
`aside` slot is visible by default meanwhile `actions` slot are only visible when the tree item is active.

`actions` slot supports a `visible` prop to force visibility of the actions.

props.name: aside
props.description: Aside content is normally used to render a badge or other non-actionable content

props.name: description
props.description: Secondary text that describes or complements the content

props.name: expandIcon
props.description:
Expand icon slot,
by default renders a chevron icon to indicate opening and closing
